titles.en: Welcome to the Forum · mingjian.cc opens its discussion layer
titles.zh: 论坛开张 · mingjian.cc 开放讨论层

summaries.en: After two and a half months of silence, mingjian.cc is not merely repaired. It is reborn as a forum. Here is what we are building and how to participate.
summaries.zh: 两个半月的沉寂之后，mingjian.cc 不只是被修复了。它以论坛的形态重生了。这是要建什么，以及如何参与。
